tasks.title: fetch_program_board() service: query, JSONB validation, MoM computation, card assembly
tasks.notes: Query: SELECT * FROM program_summary ORDER BY tokens DESC OFFSET :offset LIMIT :limit, plus a COUNT(*) for total (mirrors fetch_program_releases's paired-query pattern). _validate_sparkline(raw) -> list[dict]: null/missing/non-list/malformed-element all fall back to [] (research C-2). _compute_mom(points) -> (pct|None, direction|None): 0 or 1 points -> (None,None); >=2 points -> pct=round((last-prev)/prev*100,1) with divide-by-zero guard (prev==0 -> pct=None but direction still computed from the raw delta per FR-3's table), direction via ±0.05% threshold -> up/down/flat (research C-3). _BOARD_METRIC_GLYPHS_LABELS fixed 4-tuple constant (D-03) zipped with format_number() of tokens/releases/features/active_contributors. repos_with_harness_installed/repos_total pass through as raw ints (no ratio composed server-side per FR-1 rationale).

tasks.notes: _board_page_params dependency (D-02): page default 1 ge=1, page_size default 20 ge=1, clamp via min(page_size, MAX_PAGE_SIZE) reusing app.dependencies.pagination.MAX_PAGE_SIZE. Route: await org_access(current_user) FIRST (403, no data body, non-CIO -- AC-2), then call fetch_program_board. Empty org -> 200 {items:[],page:1,page_size:20,total:0} falls out naturally from the query (AC-5, no special-casing needed). tasks.title: ProgramSparkline inline SVG component
tasks.notes: Ports DESIGN.md's spark() geometry verbatim: viewBox '0 0 240 56' preserveAspectRatio='none', pad=4, x=pad+(i/(n-1))*(W-pad*2), y=pad+(1-(v-min)/rng)*(H-pad*2-6) with rng=(max-min)||1, stroke=typeColor width 2.4 round cap/join, linearGradient fill 0.22->0 opacity, end dot r=4 fill #fff stroke=typeColor. Divide-by-zero guards: n===1 renders a single centered dot (no line), n===0 renders an empty 56px-tall panel body (no axes, no text). role='img' aria-hidden='true' per DESIGN.md Keyboard/AT section (MoM chip already states the trend numerically).
